display.purpose: Home hero headline only, Schibsted Grotesk 600.

headline.purpose: Section headings, one line on wide screens.

price.purpose: Money values in Figtree 600 with tabular figures.

figure.purpose: Ticking clocks, bids and code digits in Figtree 600 tabular.

step-number.purpose: Plain vermilion step numerals, Schibsted 600, no tile.

shadows.name: held-rule
shadows.purpose: The one 2px vermilion top rule on the held-money cell; the category strip's first item uses inset 0 -2px 0.

motion.name: ease-rise
motion.purpose: Hero entrance (rise 600ms, window slide 800ms after 200ms) and photo zoom (400ms).

motion.name: hover-fast
motion.purpose: Button and chip colour and 2px lift transitions.

motion.name: ping
motion.purpose: Live dots (vermilion in the hero, error pink on the auction).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion disables every animation; WebGL ground draws one still frame.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one hot action: Sell, search submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 4px; background: #ff6b35; color: #0a1018; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 140ms, background 140ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ff8a5c; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hero Search
components.description: The single action in the hero: a white field with a vermilion submit.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; max-width: 34rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.375rem 0.375rem 1rem; border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.96); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #ff6b35; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 48px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: #0f1720; } .ds-search button { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #ff6b35; color: #0a1018; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-search button:hover { background: #ff8a5c; }

components.name: Category Strip
components.description: A ruled row of categories; the first item carries the one vermilion underline.
components.html:

components.name: Ruled Cell
components.description: A cell in the ruled grid: page colour, no fill, no box; the hairline comes from the grid gap.
components.html:

narrative.overview: TrustBazaar is a marketplace for buyers in Bangladesh, in English and Bangla at equal weight. The shipped home page is a bottle-green black ground with white-grey text and a single vermilion that does all the calling. The page proves safety by showing the mechanism (a real listing, a live clock, a "Payment held" card) rather than asserting it with a badge. The system is ruled, not boxed. Below the hero there are no filled cards: sections are separated by 1px hairlines, and grids are cells in the page colour over a 1px gap that shows the hairline colour. Depth comes from lines and tone, not shadow. The one exception is the hero, which carries a moving WebGL gradient ground and a frosted-glass product window with a passing sheen; these exist only on the home hero and are not part of the shared system. Colour has jobs. Vermilion is for actions, the live signal, step figures and the single rule on the held-money cell. Protect Green marks money that is held and sellers that are verified. Error Pink is only for errors and the last-hour auction clock.
keyCharacteristics: Dark theme on the user app (`data-theme="dark"`); the console, ID check and credentials pages stay on the light tokens.
Ruled Grid: hairlines and cells, no filled cards; radii nearly square (4px boxes, 6px controls).
Schibsted Grotesk 600 for headlines, Figtree for text and every figure.
Hero fills the first screen alone; its moving ground falls back to a still CSS gradient.
44px minimum tap targets; reduced motion switches every animation off.

rules.name: The One Hot Colour Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is the only hot colour. It marks an action, a live signal or a single rule or figure; it is never a large fill and never carries white text.

rules.name: The Protect Green Rule
rules.body: Green means held or verified money and nothing else. Do not use it for "success" decoration or for brand accent.

rules.name: The Ticking Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number, static or ticking (clocks, prices, bids, codes), is Figtree with `tabular-nums`. Schibsted Grotesk sets words, and the step numerals only.

rules.name: The Bangla Face Rule
rules.body: In Bangla the stack becomes `TB Figures, Hind Siliguri, Figtree`, line height 1.7 for body and 1.3 to 1.4 for headings, headings drop to weight 500 with letter-spacing 0. Digits, the taka sign and the separators between them always come from TB Figures so numbers read in one face.

rules.name: The Ruled Grid Rule
rules.body: Lines, not boxes. Separate content with 1px hairlines (`--tb-line`) and ruled cells; do not fill a card, do not outline one with a box. A section, strip, list or code is a rule above it, rules between its cells, and nothing else.

rules.name: The Home-Only Glass Rule
rules.body: The WebGL gradient ground (four-colour mesh with grain, pointer-following light, still fallback) and the frosted-glass window with its 7-second sheen exist only on the home hero. New screens do not use backdrop blur, sheen or a moving ground.

dos: **Do** separate sections and cells with 1px hairlines (#2a3b36) and gap-1px grids over the line colour; radii of 4 (boxes), 6 (controls).
**Do** reserve vermilion (#ff6b35) for actions, live signals, step figures and the single held-money top rule, with #0a1018 text on it.
**Do** use Protect Green only for held or verified states.
**Do** set headings in Schibsted Grotesk 600 and every number in Figtree with tabular numerals.
**Do** keep tap targets at 44px minimum and design for 320px, phones under 768, tablets 768 to 1023, laptops 1024 and up.
**Do** keep a still fallback for any animation and honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** keep Bangla on Hind Siliguri with the TB Figures digits first in the stack, at line height 1.7.
donts: **Don't** fill a card or box a section on the home; use a rule.
**Don't** use the WebGL ground, backdrop blur or the glass sheen outside the home hero.
**Don't** put white text on vermilion or use vermilion as a large background fill.
**Don't** put the step numbers in a tile or circle.
**Don't** use Protect Green or Error Pink as decoration.
**Don't** set a number in Schibsted Grotesk.
**Don't** convey state by colour alone; the timeline pairs fill with text weight and the clock pairs colour with its label.
